pcFileReceiveOnce.lifetime: single file, max 240 sec, QR expiration
pcFileReceiveOnce.consent: PC YES + Android QR proof + separate Windows SEND + Android file approval
pcFileReceiveOnce.hash: SHA-256 verified before Android Save As

privateDebugLab.status: private CI preview only; manual QA checklist, no PC/network API

pcFileUploadOnce.lifetime: single file, max 240 sec, QR expiration
pcFileUploadOnce.consent: PC YES + Android QR-v3 identity proof + separate Windows RECEIVE + separate Android upload approval

privateDebugLab.status: private CI preview only; two-direction manual QA checklist, no privileged JS PC/network API
